label: deterministic-controls
status: Deterministic controls executed. Deterministic HAR cohort not run (infeasible). Native cohort not run. Library ablation (arm D) not run.
method: Actual offline execution: hash checks of the frozen roster and arm bytes, recomputation of the R13 synthetic-control A versus B pairs, register refusal checks and unittest runs. The generator is a scratch script that is not committed; every number below is reproducible with the committed tests/harness_guidance_double.py and the commands in executedChecks.

deterministicCohort: R8: arm C is deferred. No real proposer, no manifest/policy/prober for a refinement round, so register cannot bind a chosen arm-C candidate. The only deterministic route (keep-base) gives C = A and carries no information.

R11: authorized but not performed. 0 harness_verification.Unit objects (task input, frozen rubric, deterministic oracle, unit hash) exist for the 7 roster cases; no unit hashes are in a freeze record.
Fallback partition: the holdout is one lineage (L1), so every comparison is descriptive-only under D3 even if the cohort ran.
blockers.libraryAblation: Arm D needs arm C and the cohort registration, so T006 being done does not make it runnable.
blockers.nativeCohort: Pending SPEC-049/T004 (native admission, owner-gated) and SPEC-048/T008 (qualified host). Not run; not substituted with synthetic data.

syntheticControl.label: synthetic-control
syntheticControl.meaning: Engineering positive control only. It shows that guidance bytes reach a guidance-reading double and that arms A and B are distinguishable where the frozen mapping predicts. The double encodes the behaviour it then reports, so these rows are not evidence that any guidance helps and are excluded from every D4 verdict. B ending interrupted on drift cases is the designed stop-on-drift switch, not a failure and not a win. A completes the drift cases only because the double ignores drift by construction.

limits: Offline controls only. No fixture solver reading guidance beyond the R13 double, host, model, native session, paid route or human annotation was used. No inferential, economic, adoption or promotion claim. executionAuthorization, nativeAdmission and promotionAuthorization are false. The reviews of this change were run by Claude subagents and are not independent Luna review. Claims are limited to the synthetic domain.
